response.description: A data field which describes the type of control used in the experiment.
response.label: experimental specimen role type

response.description: PCDS: If the sample is associated with a particular collection, provide the name of the sample collection. Type culture collection names can be referenced here. Private collections and sample collection project names can also be included.
response.label: sample collection name

response.description: A data field which describes the type of animal or plant population inhabiting an area.
response.label: animal or plant population

response.description: An environmental material collection process in which a water or soil sample is taken at a single point of time using a container type known as a grab sampler.
response.label: grab sampling

response.description: A data field which describes the name and description of the laboratory host used to propagate the source organism or material from which the sample was obtained.
response.label: lab host

response.description: A data field which describes metrics regarding the prevalence of the pathogen of interest obtained from a surveillance project.
response.label: prevalence metrics

response.description: A data field which describes the relationship of the current specimen to the specimen/sample previously submitted to the repository.
response.label: related specimen relationship type field category

response.description: PCDS: If travel history is available, but the details of travel cannot be provided, indicate this and the type of travel history availble by selecting a value from the picklist. The values in this field can be used to indicate a sample is associated with a travel when the 'purpose of sequencing' is not travel-associated.
response.label: travel history availability

response.description: A physical characterization data tag which indicates the presence of data that describes turbidity measurement.
response.label: turbidity measurement tag

response.description: A brand of of test tube specifically designed for venipuncture; the tube contains a vacuum allowing it to suck blood though a needle and fill itself. The tube may contain additives to facilitate downstream processing and testing of the blood samples; the tube cap is color-coded to indicate the type of additive present.
response.label: Vacutainer
